summary_md: **Darkly Energized ([@ka1n0s](https://x.com/ka1n0s/status/2115634802858836327))** runs **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next (125B MoE, 6B active)** locally on an M5 Max via mlx-serve with an iQ-MLX 4.7bpw pack (~82 GB resident), reporting 199/200 on an invoice-coding task and 7/8 on a site-scrape task, with results posted to evals.darkmux.com; a follow-up reply adds further eval notes.
